final: WITH counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_orders FROM counts), kept AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.order_count, c.order_count - x.average_orders AS above_average FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN avg_all AS x WHERE c.order_count > x.average_orders) SELECT account_id, order_count, above_average, above_average - AVG(above_average) OVER () AS above_kept_average FROM kept ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC, account_id LIMIT 10
